purpose: Name which concurrent lane owns which path, so a patch can be PROVEN not to mix lanes instead of being promised not to. Written 2026-08-02 for item 1 of the operator route: 'Resolve the mixed-tree problem before implementation. No mixed Garden + transcription + typography patch.' Read by scripts/check_lane_boundary.py.
why_this_exists: Several sessions edit this one checkout at the same time. Two sessions writing one file both apply cleanly and neither errors, so a lost update is silent; and a commit taken with no pathspec sweeps up whatever another lane happens to have staged. The rule was previously a sentence somebody had to remember. This file makes it a thing a script can check.
rules: Every changed path in the checkout must match exactly one lane. An unmatched path is an ERROR, not a default, so this manifest cannot go quietly stale as the tree grows.

A patch may touch paths from exactly one lane, plus shared-canon. shared-canon is append-only prose that every lane writes to; it is separated so that a doc entry does not, by itself, make a patch mixed.

A path listed in `contended` holds work from more than one lane inside ONE uncommitted diff. Path scoping cannot separate those; they must be split hunk by hunk or left out of the patch entirely. Listing a contended path in a patch is an error even when the lane matches.
This manifest describes ownership of PATHS, not of ideas. A lane that needs a change inside another lane's file asks that lane; it does not edit the file.

garden-presentation.summary: The Garden: browser and terminal renderers, world/projection, atlas, presentation registers, and their tests. The lane executing the operator route.

transcription.summary: Recovering the deployed monospace art from reference captures: recognizers, geometry routing, corpus, fixtures and the research corpus. Over 900 of this checkout's changed entries belong to this lane.

letter-typography.summary: The letter itself: justification, measured typography, paragraph line boxes. Three of the five standing Python failures belong to this lane. It owns no path exclusively today — every file it is changing is listed under `contended`, which is precisely the problem item 1 names.

author-product.summary: Author-side authoring and export, and the recipient entry points.

shared-canon.summary: Prose every lane appends to. Not a lane of its own: a patch may carry shared-canon paths alongside its own lane. Concurrent edits here are expected and must be appends, never rewrites of another lane's paragraph.

contended.consequence: A Garden patch that includes this path ships uncommitted typography work. Split by hunk or leave the file out.

cannot_be_decided_by_a_lane: As of 2026-08-02 the index holds 943 STAGED paths, 722 of them under tracked/LateLetterResearch, staged by the transcription lane. A commit with no pathspec from any lane would carry them. Only the operator can say whether that work is committed by its owner, unstaged, or left standing.
